Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. As part of our procurement checklist we'll need the following to close SOC2 sign-off and move the MSA forward: a copy of the latest SOC2 type II report or at minimum the SOC2 snapshot that covers the controls related to access controls and change management; a proposed pen-test window with details on how you handle production access; and language for the security exhibit that limits audit impact on production while preserving our right to validate controls.

Could you share a proposed cadence for regular evidence handoffs (logs, control evidence) and confirm whether you permit vendor-run penetration tests against production components (if so, what scoping/guardrails are required)? Also, our procurement team requires the MSA redline to land in your legal queue before next-week negotiation with our legal — are you able to confirm that will happen?

Attachment: - sample-questionnaire-nimbus.docx (we completed the first pass)

Best,

Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick status and proposed approach:
- SOC2: attaching SOC2_snapshot_2026Q2.pdf (redacted) for initial review.
- Pen test: we can support vendor-run tests but require an approved scope and a defined window. I propose a 48-hour production window with canary/traffic isolation where possible. Full details are in the pen_test_scope_draft.docx I'm sharing internally now.
- Evidence cadence: propose quarterly evidence bundle for controls plus on-demand access to logs for 30 days following an incident; we'll include a 90-day rolling log export option if you need longer retention (we can set up a cost+retention add-on).
- MSA/legal queue: looping Laura and Karthik to triage the redline. Laura: can you intake the redline and let Sara know timing for legal review? Karthik: FYI on pen-test access + any procurement escalations.

I will follow up with a consolidated reply to your procurement and a DocuSign for the NDA + pen test authorization if that helps speed the vendor review.

Thanks,

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MSA + security exhibit follow-up — SOC2 evidence & pen test

Vivek / Karthik —

I reviewed the inbound requests and drafted a short form security exhibit that we can attach to the MSA as Exhibit B. High-level guidance and redline notes below — I'll drop the redline file in the shared drive (redline_msa_security_exhibit_v2.docx).

Key proposals (legal):
1) Audit rights: allow customer to perform audits or engage a mutually approved third-party auditor, limited to (a) verification of controls in scope, (b) reasonable advance notice (14 business days), and (c) business hours access. We must include a non-disruptive carveout: no intrusive testing on production infrastructure unless separately authorized and coordinated.
2) Pen-test vendor access: require vendor pre-approval, execution of our standard pen-test NDA, and a scoped IP allowlist. Vendor must follow our runbook (provided) and use a dedicated window with rollback/response contacts.
3) Evidence cadence: quarterly evidence bundles (control docs + SOC2 snapshot) delivered via secure drive link; ad-hoc requests for logs limited to 1x per quarter unless tied to an incident. Additional retention windows are chargeable and require a subscription change.
4) Incident forensics: we will provide sufficient logs and run forensic exports to aid investigation; deep forensic work that requires memory images or persistent snapshots of production hosts will require a separate agreement.

Timing: I can accept their redlines into our legal queue and aim to return a consolidated comment set in 3 business days (so by Tue 2026-09-01). If procurement needs faster turnaround we'll escalate to outside counsel for a priority review.

I'll attach the redline and a short comment matrix for Vivek to send to Sara.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + security exhibit follow-up — SOC2 evidence & pen test

Sara —

Thanks for the patience — attached are three items for your review: SOC2_snapshot_2026Q2.pdf (redacted), pen_test_scope_draft.docx (vendor requirements and proposed windows), and a redline of the security exhibit (redline_msa_security_exhibit_v2.docx). High level summary:

- Pen-test window: proposed Nov 2–6, 2026 (Mon–Fri) with a 48-hour high-impact test window within that range. Tests must be performed by a pre-approved vendor (e.g., Tim Carter copied here) who will sign our pen-test NDA and follow the runbook.
- Production access: only external scanning allowed by default (no persistent agents). Any authenticated access to production hosts will require a separate change request and a ride-along engineer from Redwood.
- Evidence cadence: quarterly bundles via secure drive + on-demand incident exports. Standard deliveries: SOC2 snapshot, change management logs for the quarter, access control lists, and summary of open vulnerabilities remediated in last 90 days.
- Escalation / legal timing: Laura will accept your redline into our legal queue; she expects a consolidated response by Tue 2026-09-01. If NimbusHealth needs negotiation earlier we can engage our outside counsel for a paid fast-track.

Next steps I recommend: (1) confirm whether you need >90 days of log retention so we can price the add-on, (2) send us the vendor statement/credentials for Tim's shop (or your preferred vendor), and (3) upload your redline to the shared drive or send directly to laura_bennett@redwood.inference.

DocuSign (NDA + pen-test auth): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/55b3-ec2d
Shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-example-evidence

Attaching: SOC2_snapshot_2026Q2.pdf; pen_test_scope_draft.docx; redline_msa_security_exhibit_v2.docx

Best,
Vivek

Subject: Re: MSA + security exhibit follow-up — SOC2 evidence & pen test

Vivek / Laura —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the package — this is very close to what we need. A few clarifications from procurement/security before we lock dates:
1) Log retention: we need 180-day access to authentication logs for compliance. Can you confirm whether the 90-day export is the maximum without add-on pricing and what the estimated cost is for 180 days?
2) Vendor approval: Tim's team looks good; please confirm the pre-approval checklist (insurance limits, CVE handling SLA, and evidence delivery commitments).
3) Production conduct: we understand the non-persistent agent approach. For any authenticated testing requiring a ride-along engineer, please confirm a detailed scheduling SLA so that our vendor can plan.

We will upload our redline to the shared drive by EOD and Sara from procurement will follow up on DocuSign signatures. If Laura is fine with the 14-business-day notice and the non-disruptive carveout we can likely accept that language.

Thanks —
Sara
